rationale: The workflow is disabled: the job has `if: false` and the push/pull_request triggers are commented out, leaving only workflow_dispatch, and all historical CI runs are skipped. No evidence-supported optimization meaningfully applies. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE requires dependency installation steps on the runner, but this workflow only checks out code and builds/pushes a Docker image via devcontainers/ci with no pip/npm install step to cache. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST requires a matrix; P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE and P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE require schedule triggers; P-LIT-PRIORITIZE, P-LIT-SELECT, and P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST require test steps; P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT and P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT require representative successful-duration history, which does not exist because every run is skipped; P-LIT-BAZEL-* patterns require a Bazel build. Adding caching or timeouts to a disabled job would provide no benefit and would not alter intended coverage.
